function.name: triage_emergency
function.description: Checks live 24/7 emergency dispatch availability, overflow coverage, extended-hours rules, and fee disclosure for an Ocean/Monmouth County town or street address whenever a caller reports an active roof leak, ceiling water, or storm breach.

address_or_town.description: Street address or town/city in Ocean or Monmouth County (e.g. 'Toms River' or '123 Main St, Brick, NJ').

issue_summary.description: Brief summary of the active leak or storm damage.

function.name: dispatch_emergency
function.description: Logs an Emergency Priority roof leak lead and sends an immediate high-urgency SMS escalation alert to the assigned on-call roofing dispatch phone (or overflow crew).

issue_summary.description: Detailed description of the leak location, water intrusion, or storm damage.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Checks live open inspection appointment windows for a town/address or target date in Ocean & Monmouth County.

date.description: Optional preferred date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-11-16).

town_or_address.description: Optional town or street address to match the territory contractor schedule.

urgent.description: Set true for active leaks or storm damage requiring earliest available triage.

function.name: book_inspection
function.description: Books an on-site free 21-point roof inspection with the local Ocean County estimator.

email.description: Homeowner email address for calendar confirmation.

service.description: Roofing service requested (e.g. Complete Roof Replacement, Emergency Leak Repair).

function.name: request_human_callback
function.description: Logs a caller request to speak with a human representative, sends an instant email and SMS alert to the owner, and returns the exact callback window promise to read back to the homeowner.

address_or_town.description: Optional Ocean or Monmouth County town or street address.

reason.description: Concise 1-sentence reason the caller wants to speak with a human representative.

agent_name.description: AI agent handling the call (Sarah or Riley).

function.name: create_social_post
function.description: Creates and queues (or immediately publishes) a Facebook & Instagram social post from spoken owner dictation with automatic UTM tracking.

caption.description: Full polished social post caption mentioning the Ocean County town and call-to-action.

town_name.description: Ocean or Monmouth County town (e.g. Toms River, Brick).

publish_now.description: Set true to publish immediately to Facebook/Instagram, or false to place in the scheduled queue.

function.name: get_social_digest
function.description: Fetches pending social comments, Messenger/IG DMs, social reviews, and queued posts for voice briefing.

status_filter.description: Optional filter: pending_approval, auto_24h, or all.

function.name: approve_social_reply
function.description: Approves, edits, ignores, or publishes a reply to a Facebook/Instagram comment, DM, or social review.

interaction_id.description: ID of the social_interactions record (e.g. SOC-REV-...).

edited_reply.description: Optional updated reply text dictated by the owner.

function.name: publish_queued_post
function.description: Immediately publishes a queued post from social_queue to Facebook Page and Instagram Business.

post_id.description: ID of the social_queue item (e.g. SQ-...).
